layer: Georgia Transmission and MEAG Power transmission projects
about: New lines and substations of Georgia Transmission Corporation, which is owned by Georgia's electric membership corporations, and MEAG Power, which serves city-owned systems. Read from the 2026 regional transmission plan, federal environmental reviews of co-op projects, Georgia Transmission's project pages and local notices. Rebuilds, reconductoring and equipment work are left out. No transmission project owned by an individual EMC was found; EMCs appear in these sources as the utilities a project serves. Read by hand on November 23, 2026; check the sources before quoting.
